```{r}
ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = "AirBnB : New York",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    card(
      card_header("Price"),
      sliderInput(
        "price",
        "Set value",
        min = 0,
        max = 10000,
        value = c(0,10000)
      ),
    ),
    card(
      card_header("Type of room"),
      checkboxGroupInput(
        "room",
        "Select all that apply",
        choices = list("Entire home/apt" = "Entire home/apt", "Private room" = "Private room", "Shared room" = "Shared room"),
        selected = 1
      ),
    )
  ),
  card(leafletOutput("map"))

)


# Define server logic ----
server <- function(input, output) {

dataFiltred = reactive({
  if (is.null(input$room) || length(input$room) == 0) {
    subset(airbnb_clean, price > input$price[1] & price < input$price[2])
  } else {
    subset(airbnb_clean, price > input$price[1] & price < input$price[2] & room_type %in% input$room)
  }
})


  
output$map <- renderLeaflet({
  
  df=dataFiltred()
  
  long=c(df$longitude)
  lati=c(df$latitude)
  name=c(df$name)
  
  leaflet(options=leafletOptions(
  minZoom = 10,
  maxZoom = 18,
  dragging = TRUE
)) %>%
  
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron")%>%
  setView(lng = -74, lat = 40.7, zoom = 11)%>%
  setMaxBounds(
    lng1 = -73.7,
    lat1 = 40.92,
    lng2 = -74.3,
    lat2 = 40.4
  )%>%
  addMarkers(lng=long,lat = lati,popup = name,clusterOptions=markerClusterOptions(
showCoverageOnHover = TRUE,
zoomToBoundsOnClick = TRUE,
spiderfyOnMaxZoom = TRUE,
removeOutsideVisibleBounds = TRUE,
freezeAtZoom = FALSE
) )
  })
}

# Run the app ----
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```

```{r}
#Optionnel : filtrer les quartiers les plus fréquents pour plus de lisibilité
top_neighbourhoods <- airbnb_clean %>%  count(neighbourhood) %>%
  top_n(10, n) %>%
  pull(neighbourhood)

filtered_data <- airbnb_clean %>%
  filter(neighbourhood %in% top_neighbourhoods)
# Visualisation
ggplot(filtered_data, aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightblue") +  scale_y_log10() +  labs(title = "Distribution of Prices by Neighbourhood (Log Scale)",       x = "Neighbourhood",       y = "Price (log scale)") +  theme_minimal() +  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
